text:
Alex C: Morning — kicking off a POC with Zephyr Health (HIPAA customer). Planning a 4-week POC. Proposed high-level agenda: 1) discovery + security review, 2) baseline eval on their prompt set, 3) integration + test harness, 4) monitor + final review. Any additions?
Maya R: Add a dedicated compliance block: confirm SSO/SAML, data residency, and run through the InfoSec questionnaire before infra access. Also request contact for their security lead.
Samir: Quick infra question — do we offer a Dedicated trial or Private (VPC) for this POC? For HIPAA they'd prefer Private, but sales asked if we can start on Hosted to speed iteration.
Katie: I can draft pricing options. Short answer: hosted for dev testing (no PHI), Private/VPC for PHI — Private has extra setup + MRR. I’ll post a short comparison doc after this thread.
Alex C: Good. For success criteria: latency p50 <250ms, p95 <800ms, throughput 20 qps steady, and model quality >= 85% on a human-eval of 500 prompts. If those look unrealistic we can relax.
Maya R: 85% human-rated on first pass is optimistic. Suggest defining two gates: gate A (integration + stability) and gate B (quality). Gate B pass = human >= 80% on core workflows OR automated metric threshold + no major regressions on key prompts.
Samir: For the eval harness, here's a starter prompt set we propose to run (short samples only):
```
1) "Summarize patient visit note into 3 bullets"
2) "Extract medication changes and dosages"
3) "Given symptoms X, Y, suggest next steps (triage)"
4) "Rewrite clinical note for billing with ICD codes"
```
We should ask Zephyr to provide 200 redacted real examples for baseline + 300 synthetic/edge cases.
Katie: I'll request a legal/phi-safe sample checklist to send them. Also we need to confirm SOC2 status and any additional attestation.
Alex C: Who owns collection of prompts and gold labels from the customer? Samir you can own the eval harness; Katie can own contract/pricing; Maya own security touchpoints; I'll own stakeholder coordination.
Maya R: Security discovery questions to send Zephyr (short list):
- Do you require BAA?
- Are we allowed to persist logs/token cache containing PHI?
- Preferred KMS for key management? (AWS KMS / customer HSM?)
- SSO provider and SCIM/SCIM provisioning needs
We should also ask for their security contact email.
Samir: Timeline proposal: Week 0 (kickoff + security Qs), Week 1 (baseline eval + hosted smoke if allowed), Week 2 (integration on Private/VPC), Week 3 (full eval + human review), Week 4 (final review + go/no-go). If they want faster, compress to 3 weeks but higher risk.
Katie: Pricing note: I'll share a ballpark in the next 2 hours. For POC we can offer a time-limited discounted Dedicated pool for testing (internal approval required).
Alex C: Meeting agenda for kickoff with Zephyr (30–45m):
- Introductions & stakeholders (5m)
- POC goals & success criteria (10m)
- Data & security requirements (10m)
- Eval plan + prompts + timeline (7m)
- Next steps & owners (3m)
Can someone add anything?
Maya R: Add escalation path and access gating in next steps. Also request their compliance lead join or be on-call during week0.
Samir: I'll prepare the eval harness repo and a small script we can give them to run locally:
```bash
python run_eval.py --model redwood-gpt-mini --input prompts.csv --out results.json
```
We should include expected metrics: exact match %, BLEU, human_score.
ops-bot: Created calendar invite: "Zephyr POC Kickoff" Thu 10:00am (invite shared with Alex C, Maya R, Samir, Katie).
Katie: FYI — Zephyr indicated in the RFP they have an internal pentest schedule. We should confirm whether they require us to run an additional pen test for the private deployment.
Alex C: Action items I will track:
- Alex: send kickoff agenda + invite (today)
- Maya: send security question set and request SOC2/BAA docs (today)
- Samir: prep eval harness + sample prompts (tomorrow)
- Katie: pricing + dedicated vs private comparison (EOD)
I'll also include a short checklist in the kickoff notes. Anything else before I lock the invite?
Maya R: Add note to request a small safe sample dataset (redacted) and their acceptance criteria for data handling during eval.
Samir: Also ask whether we should seed KV cache or use cold starts for baseline. That affects latency targets.
Katie: I'll add pricing + sample invoice terms to the kickoff deck.
Alex C: Perfect — locking invite now. Will post follow-ups in this thread with docs/links. Thanks team :thumbsup:
